signals.signal: CBK 'Use of Bank Cards in Kosovo' (Sept-2025 edition, data at 31/12/2024): 21,548 card-accepting terminals = 635 ATMs + 20,913 POS. Of 635 ATMs, 634 do cash withdrawal, 377 accept cash deposit, only 53 support credit transfer. Fleet grew 583 (2023) -> 635 (2024); deposit-capable grew 326 -> 377. POS with cash-withdrawal (cashback) function: just 18.
signals.source_name: CBK - Use of Bank Cards in Kosovo, September 2025
signals.implies: Only 59% of Kosovo's ATM estate accepts deposits and 8% supports credit transfer - a quantified gap for Printec cash recyclers/deposit ATMs and for ATM application software adding transfer and bill-pay functions.
signals.likelihood: High - deposit-ATM conversion is the visible growth vector (+51 deposit units in one year)
signals.followup: Obtain the 2026 edition (data at 31/12/2025) to size the per-bank deposit gap.

signals.signal: The TIPS Clone instant-payment settlement platform for the Western Balkans went live 20/07/2026 with the central banks of Bosnia & Herzegovina and Montenegro. Banca d'Italia states a SECOND ONBOARDING WINDOW is scheduled for NOVEMBER 2026, when the central banks of Albania, Kosovo and North Macedonia are expected to join.
signals.source_name: Banca d'Italia - TIPS Clone platform for instant payments in the Western Balkans goes live
signals.implies: A hard, dated national infrastructure deadline. Every Kosovo bank must connect to 24/7 instant settlement within ~4 months - driving payment-hub/transaction-processing work, 24/7 real-time fraud and transaction monitoring, AML screening at instant speed, and HSM/security capacity. Printec sells all four.
signals.likelihood: High - date is published by the operating central bank
signals.followup: Confirm the Kosovo scheme operator (CBK vs a national ACH) and which banks are in the first participant wave; approach before the November window.

signals.entity: Government of Kosovo / Assembly - Draft Law on Payment Services
signals.signal: A new Draft Law on Payment Services was approved at the 8th Government meeting by Decision No. 08/08 dated 03/04/2026 (255-page trilingual text). It is PSD2-aligned and introduces: SEPA payment schemes and euro instant credit transfers as defined categories; 'advanced/strong customer authentication' requiring two or more independent knowledge/possession/inherence elements; a licensing carve-out for independent ATM deployers acting for card issuers who must disclose withdrawal charges; and mandatory disclosure of all charges and the exchange rate for dynamic currency conversion offered at an ATM or POS.
signals.source_name: Office of the Prime Minister of Kosovo - PROJEKTLIGJI PER SHERBIMET E PAGESAVE (Draft Law on Payment Services)
signals.implies: Compliance-driven refresh of the whole self-service and acquiring estate: SCA on cards and channels, DCC screen-flow changes on every ATM and POS, and a legal route for independent (non-bank) ATM operators in Kosovo - a new customer class for Printec ATM-as-a-service and managed services.
signals.likelihood: High for enactment (SEPA membership depends on it); Medium on timing
signals.followup: Track Assembly adoption and the CBK secondary regulations; the ATM DCC and SCA articles set concrete software change dates.

signals.entity: Assembly of Kosovo / CBK - Law on Banks
signals.signal: Law No. 08/L-304 on Banks was published in the Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo No. 2 of 27/01/2026. The text is explicitly harmonised with EU acquis (CRR 575/2013, CRD 2013/36/EU, BRRD 2014/59/EU). Entry into force of this law was the blocker CBK cited for filing Kosovo's FINAL SEPA application, the pre-application having been completed 14/10/2024 and updated 20/12/2024.
signals.source_name: Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo No.2 - LIGJI NR. 08/L-304 PER BANKAT
signals.implies: The legal blocker to SEPA is clearing. SEPA accession forces IBAN/ISO 20022 message alignment, sanctions and AML screening on cross-border euro flows, and re-certification of payment rails - Printec AML/compliance and transaction-monitoring scope.
signals.followup: Confirm whether the final SEPA application has now been filed with DG FISMA / EPC and the expected decision date.

signals.signal: Annual Report 2025: the ATM network EXPANDED FROM 156 TO 168 UNITS during 2025 (+12, +7.7%) while the branch count held at 35. 362,000 active customers (+9% YoY), 200,000 digitally active, digital channels carried 98% of all transactions, mobile transaction volume +85%. Digital onboarding: 76% of new-to-bank private customers joined via digital channels and 20% completed fully end-to-end online; SME digitally-onboarded customers +130%. Launched RAIA, described as the first AI virtual assistant in the local banking market (~60,000 interactions, 82% resolved without a human).
signals.implies: Kosovo's largest bank is GROWING its ATM fleet while holding branches flat - the classic branch-to-self-service migration Printec sells into (recyclers, ATM software, managed services). The 20% fully-online onboarding figure versus 76% digitally-started is an explicit eKYC completion gap.
signals.likelihood: High - expansion is already in-flight and disclosed
signals.followup: Identify the OEM behind the 12 new 2025 units and whether the 2026 plan continues the run-rate; baseline figure of '142 cash/ATM points, 75 cash-in' is now superseded.

signals.likelihood: High - notices are explicitly annual and recurring
signals.followup: Register as a supplier; the banking-equipment lot recurs ~July-2027. Direct URL: https://bekonomike.com/en/invitation-to-tender-meeting-the-banks-annual-requirements-for-the-supply-and-servicing-of-banking-equipment/
